title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Taper on Repeated Additional Visits
content:
## Price list footnote

The unit price an additional visit is taken at, on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record, tapers with how many such visits the agreement has already been charged for. The count is of the charges for a visit beyond the visits the term credited already standing on the agreement.

| Charges for a visit beyond the visits the term credited already standing on the agreement | Unit price the visit is taken at |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | the additional visit price the tier publishes taken at the repeat visit share, that is 80 percent of it |
| 1 or 2 | the additional visit price the tier publishes taken at the second visit share, that is 90 percent of it |
| none | the additional visit price the tier publishes |

### Footnote notes

- At a count of exactly 3 the repeat visit share of 80 percent applies; at a count of exactly 1 and at a count of exactly 2 the second visit share of 90 percent applies.
- The share acts on the additional visit price published for the agreement's own tier.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

At a tier publishing an additional visit price of 340.00 USD: with no such charge standing, the unit price is 340.00 USD; with 2 standing, it is 90 percent of 340.00 USD, that is 306.00 USD; with 4 standing, it is 80 percent of 340.00 USD, that is 272.00 USD.
